questions.prompt: Is this mainly about the work itself, or about people/relationships around it?
When you think about 'the work,' is the pain more about the amount or pace of it, or about the systems and process surrounding it?
Is it clear what 'done' looks like for your work, or does the target keep shifting or stay undefined?

options.label: Pretty clear, I just don't have the time or capacity

questions.prompt: Are your day-to-day tools or process actually broken, or fine, but the underlying code/system is fragile?
Is the blocker more 'things move too slowly through review/deploy,' or 'nobody really knows how this part works'?

options.label: Nobody really knows how it works

questions.prompt: When something breaks in this area, is it clear whose job it is to fix it?

options.label: No, it's unclear or nobody owns it

questions.prompt: Is this bleeding into your personal time or energy outside work hours?
Do you feel equipped and skilled for what's being asked of you?

options.label: Not really, it's outside my skillset
I have the skills, just not the time or support

questions.prompt: Do you see a real path to grow or take on more scope here?

options.label: A path exists, that's not the issue

questions.prompt: Do you feel micromanaged or unable to make your own calls?

options.label: No, I have freedom to decide

questions.prompt: Is the friction mostly with one specific person, or a broader pattern across your manager, team, or org?
Does your manager give you support or feedback when you need it?
Do you feel your contributions are seen and acknowledged?
Is the coworker friction more about how work or credit gets divided, or a personal/style clash?

options.label: How work or credit is divided

questions.prompt: Has the workload or pace been unsustainable for weeks, or is this a recent spike?
Is part of this about pay or advancement feeling stalled?

options.label: No, it's not about pay or title

questions.prompt: If you had to step away for two weeks, would things fall apart without you?

options.label: Yes, I'm the only one who knows this

questions.prompt: Is the code/system causing pain old and rarely touched, or actively being changed but still breaking?

options.label: Old, rarely touched, scary to change

questions.prompt: Does getting a change reviewed or shipped take much longer than doing the work itself?

options.label: Yes, review/deploy is the real bottleneck

questions.prompt: How long has this specific issue been bothering you?
